mapper.select: SELECT al.id, al.action, al.from_status AS fromStatus, al.to_status AS toStatus, al.opinion, al.admin_id AS adminId, al.create_time AS createTime, a.name AS adminName FROM audit_log al LEFT JOIN admin_info a ON al.admin_id = a.id WHERE al.audit_id = #{auditId} ORDER BY al.create_time ASC
